facts.label: Nota e superlativos
facts.sub: Use o passado para contar a prova e superlativos para destacar: It was the hardest test. It was the most difficult question.

facts.label: Adjetivos curtos
facts.sub: Com adjetivos curtos, use the + -est: the hardest test, the biggest castle, the oldest castle, the longest essay. Big dobra o g: biggest.

facts.label: Adjetivos longos
facts.sub: Com adjetivos longos, use the most + adjetivo: the most difficult question, the most famous castle. Não diga difficultest nem more difficult aqui. Para três ou mais coisas, o superlativo mostra qual é o número um.

items.s: The superlative of big is biggest.
The superlative of good is goodest.
The superlative of bad is worst.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The superlative of big is biggest. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
The superlative of good is goodest. → Falso (It is best.)
The superlative of bad is worst. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A big school · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a big school in Liverpool. Students stand in the hall with papers. Luisa holds her history test. Her friend Noel walks over. She has a big smile on her face. Noel wants to know the grade.
“Hi, Luisa! You look happy. Did you get your grade?” says Noel. “Yes! I got an A in history. It’s my best grade this year!” says Luisa. “Wow! Was it the hardest test?” says Noel.
